Standard-target baseline for the study targets above (MDC2025ba_st*): the same CE settings, standard geometry geom_run1_a.txt, and the standard Run 1A stop pool MuminusStopsCat.MDC2025ac (from TargetStops.MDC2025ac: 4e9 draws, prescale 1000, 1.44M stops). The stop pool predates StageNormalization; MDC2025ba's TargetStopResampler read it without error in the 2026-10-29 MuStopPileup no-IPA runs. Its only copy is on tape.

Run 1A high-energy muon-capture protons for Michael MacKenzie's request (2026-10): stops from MuminusStopsCat.MDC2025ac with the geom_run1_a override all Run1A primaries carry; filter keeps the defaults except MinimumSumCaloStepE 20 (matches Run 1B). Smoke at MDC2025bb 2026-11-03: 2.25% pass, VmHWM 2527 MB (above the 2500MB default, hence 3000MB). Sizing matches Run 1B: 200 x 500k draws. Output on disk: it is the one-file-per-job input of the Mix1BB entry in mix.json.

Run 1A calo-pointed muon-capture neutrons, same setup and request as MuCapProtonTail above. Smoke at MDC2025bb 2026-11-03: 6.3% pass (627 of 10k draws), VmHWM 2540 MB, so 3000MB like the proton entry (user decision). Sizing matches Run 1B: 1000 x 125k draws.

Run 1A COL5 flat gamma (carbon RMC in the calorimeter) for Michael MacKenzie's request (DM 2026-11-06: flat gamma plus calo-aimed only). Resamples the Run 1A COL5 mu- stops (MuminusPolyStopsCat.MDC2025bb, 335k stops, campaign 179) through geom_run1_a, the default Run 1A field. Same filter and sizing as Run 1B's PolyFlatGamma.Run1Bap: 1000 x 1M draws. Smoke at MDC2025bb 2026-11-07, 20k draws: 8 pass (4e-4, Run 1B 8e-4), about 10 ms per draw, VmHWM 2.26 GB; so about 2.8 h and 400 events per job, about 400k events in total.

Calorimeter-aimed version of the Run 1A COL5 flat gamma above. Same settings; sizing as Run 1B's PolyFlatGammaCalo.Run1Baq: 200 x 500k draws. Smoke at MDC2025bb 2026-11-07, 20k draws: 2511 pass (12.6%), about 18 ms per draw, VmHWM 2.27 GB, 6.2 kB per event; so about 2.5 h, 63k events and 390 MB per job, about 12.6M events and 78 GB in total.

Run 1A BNV signal samples, Michael MacKenzie's request (Slack 2026-11-12): 17 scan points of the four BNVMuonCapture generators, N(gen) from his table (25.0M total, about 500k events per sample after digitization). Muon stops from MuminusStopsCat.MDC2025ac with the geom_run1_a override all Run 1A primaries carry. Needs the release with the BNV nucleus-mass fix (Offline PR #2127). Full chain: Mix1BB (mix.json), reco (reco.json), ntuples (evntuple.json). Fcl-default points carry no generator override. Smoke at MDC2025bc 2026-11-12, 200 events per fcl default: PrimaryFilter keeps 52% (EmDarkFermion), 40% (DarkCascade), 41% (DarkCascadeElectron), 38% (LongLived 30 ns), in line with Michael's acceptances; 0.06-0.085 s per event; VmHWM 2.40 GB (under the 2500MB default); about 25 kB per kept event. So 20k draws per job: about 25 min and 250 MB per job, 1250 jobs, about 210 GB of dts on disk in total.
